picks.title: She Was Never Alone
picks.author: Skye Arden
picks.tagline: The office that should have been her safest room no longer feels like one.
picks.blurb: Nina Calloway has taught people, for eighteen years, to listen to the gut feeling that keeps them alive. Now that same gut feeling starts to read like an illness. A client who just moved into 5C insists that someone above her is keeping watch. Nina's notepad shifts while she is out, then returns to where it was. The building itself seems built to carry sound, and each unwatched corner already appears to belong to someone.

picks.title: Silent Night Protocol
picks.author: Christie Winter
picks.kicker: A Psychological Thriller · Free on BookFunnel with a newsletter sign-up
picks.tagline: The most dangerous voice he hears may not be his own.
picks.blurb: Winter's lead is also named Ryan, and he is not Ryan Kane. Recruiters picked him because he does not crack. Then a classified program called Silent Night Protocol starts taking pieces of him: stretches of time he cannot account for, notes in his handwriting that he cannot recall, and camera records of jobs he never agreed to run. Orders arrive with no transmitter behind them. Switches trip with no visible source. A person may be steering him. Or something else may be.

picks.title: The Director's Cut
picks.author: Janet Walker
picks.kicker: A Nick Waters Detective Series · On Kindle
picks.tagline: This killer does not plant clues. He plants cuts.
picks.blurb: A high-powered entertainment lawyer turns up dead, arranged as if a camera had blocked the scene. Detective Nick Waters knows the staging. He saw that same signature five years earlier, before the proof was wiped and he was made to let the file go. The new victim ties back to Zoe Valentine, Hollywood's unreachable star, and reporter Maisie Kline starts to fear that a story she once helped bury is now getting people killed.

picks.title: The Deadly Partner
picks.author: Parker Vale
picks.kicker: A Claire Beckett Psychological Thriller · Pre-order on Kindle, out November 27
picks.tagline: Claire already knows how easily a warm smile can hide a predator.
picks.blurb: Seven years back, police questioned Ben Carter after his girlfriend was found murdered. Later, a second woman named him in public; within days she was dead as well. Both cases went cold. Ben is now with Lucy, and Claire, Lucy's friend, has been hunted before. She does not believe Lucy will live through this. A blizzard is closing the roads, and Claire has to find answers while a killer remains at large.

picks.title: One Cadet's Remorse
picks.author: Evelyn Vale
picks.kicker: A One Lie Too Many Psychological Thriller · On Kindle
picks.tagline: A false charge and a closed institution stand in an ordinary woman's way.
picks.blurb: Olivia Gray goes to see her brother and walks into a crisis. Eric teaches at the Air Force Academy and is well regarded there, then faces a claim of misconduct involving a cadet. Olivia is sure the charge is false. The Academy's sealed culture stops her at every turn when she tries to clear him. Then the unsigned threats begin.

picks.title: The Phantom Orchestra
picks.author: Abilene Rose
picks.kicker: via TrendSetters Press · Liminal Academy Chronicles · A Victorian supernatural mystery
picks.tagline: The music went silent in 1873. Nobody asked why it began again.
picks.blurb: A West Wing concert hall has been locked since 1873, after a fire ended the lives of twelve gifted young players. Clara Burton, four months into the job of Assistant Headmistress, can hear that symphony at midnight. This is a Victorian supernatural mystery, book four of the Liminal Academy Chronicles.

picks.title: The Psychological Thriller Collection
picks.author: Nina Kross
picks.tagline: Three novels. Three buried secrets. Almost nothing is as it first appears.
picks.blurb: The set holds Dead Signal, The Last Wife, plus What Ava Knew, gathered as three full psychological thrillers. One thread starts with a call from a number that ought not to exist. Another starts inside a marriage that looks perfect until a discovery wrecks it. A third follows a woman who saw the whole picture and kept it to herself, until she could not.

picks.title: Woman Behind the Walls
picks.author: Ellis Bale
picks.kicker: A Gripping Psychological Thriller · Free on BookFunnel with a newsletter sign-up
picks.tagline: A polished life, a mind coming apart, and a woman who hid from herself.
picks.blurb: Lucy Crawford's Manhattan penthouse looks flawless. Then the rooms start to turn on her: air currents with no source, curtains that shift, a joint in the wall she has passed a hundred times. Behind that joint is a concealed room. Inside the room is a life she cannot remember living.

picks.title: Framed by the Dead
picks.author: Damon Harper
picks.tagline: The room already thinks it knows the killer. The room is wrong.
picks.blurb: Two writers are dead and a third has vanished. Every scrap of evidence points at bestselling author Mimi Elder: an uncommon poison, a knife still wet with blood, a trail so neat it leaves almost no room to argue. The plot looks finished before the first page.

intro:
Longview sits on I-20 in East Texas, a city framed by pine country and by lights that keep burning after the last truck has gone quiet. This page is for readers in Longview who want nine fresh thrillers collected in one spot, along with a short story you can finish without leaving the page. None of the nine novels takes place here. Ryan Kane's books are not a Texas series. I am not treating these titles as a local crime blotter. They are recommendations from other writers, each offered with a single outbound link, then a brief free read, then my prequel.

The longer cards belong to Skye Arden, Christie Winter, Janet Walker, and Parker Vale. Vale's book is a Kindle pre-order scheduled to release on November 27. The shorter cards belong to Evelyn Vale, Abilene Rose (published through TrendSetters Press), Nina Kross, Ellis Bale, and Damon Harper. Titles, hooks, and links sit on the cards below.

Pump Six comes next. A night clerk at a filling station watches a dark sedan idle at a pump and never take any fuel. I wrote that piece alongside the Ryan Kane novels; it is not a chapter pulled from a book already in print. Below it sits HUNTED, the series prequel, which you can download at no charge on BookFunnel, then FRACTURED GROUND as a Kindle edition and the Digital Ascent advance copy on BookSprout.
